description: This file contains test scripts for verifying Git hook behaviors, specifically testing the 'proc-receive' hook and handling of unknown references during push operations. It uses shell commands to simulate Git operations and checks the hook responses.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up and executes a shell-based test hook, simulating server-side Git hook behavior.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.
